checks.message: The package consistently identifies ItsVeyra, Codex, the Chinese and English titles, and Chinese as the primary language.
Codex is explicitly identified as an AI agent; generated assets are not attributed to a human author.

The repository-supplied provisional boundary is clearly labeled low-confidence and non-official; manifest data_confidence=low describes these spatial inputs, not package validation quality. It supports concept organization only and must be replaced and recalculated when the official redline is supplied.
All three required key areas are present and clearly labeled as provisional constraints that must be replaced and recalculated when official polygons are supplied.
The concept land-use polygons form a gapless, non-overlapping partition of the provisional site boundary; this is a topology check, not a statutory land-use claim.
The static HTML visualization is complete and uses no external dependencies, remote tiles, network requests, forms, iframes, or tracking.
The proposal and matrices provide traceable references to standards, design-depth items, geometry, metrics, sources, assumptions, governance limits, and human review paths.

AI scenarios retain resident choice and explicit consent, withdrawal, escalation, pilot stop, and qualified human review boundaries; AI does not make final medical, safety, eligibility, planning, or funding decisions.

All five required proposal figures are substantive 2560 by 1700 pixel outputs, exceeding the minimum 2400 by 1600 requirement; they are derived from the package geometry and metrics, with provisional status visibly disclosed.
Both required PDFs contain rendered pages at the declared A3 landscape and A0 landscape paper sizes and were visually checked for clipping, overlap, empty pages, and missing glyphs.
